entries.title: Cards on iPhone and iPad follow your Text Size
entries.body: A card's words on your iPhone or iPad now read at the phone's own size, and grow when you make text larger in iOS, up to its largest standard size; panels do too. Words inside a card's diagram keep their size. To make text larger in Infinitary alone, use Text Size in Control Center. Settings → Appearance says so under Theme.

picture.alt: A note card on an iPhone at the default Text Size, its body words drawn at the phone's 17-point size under its title
